apps.summary: Browse and search arXiv, keep preprints, and read their HTML versions on your Kobo.
Turn a topic into an original narrated audiobook and listen on your Kobo.
Build a daily news brief in the background while you use other apps.
Ask a question, then read and navigate the answer with touch controls.
See every Cobalt UI component on the device in one reference app.
Browse OPDS libraries and read their books on your Kobo.
Read Top, New, Ask, and Show stories with complete comment threads.
Find the hall sensor behind the bezel and watch it respond to a magnet.
Type a message and send it in Morse code with the front light.
Follow website feeds and read their articles without the web page around them.
Review coding-agent requests across multiple terminal sessions.
apps.page_description: An e-reader board for coding-agent approvals, distinguishing simultaneous terminal sessions before an answer is sent.

steps.text: Initialize the Sidekick daemon on the computer to create its TLS certificate, address, and pairing code.
Install the printed Sidekick certificate on the Kobo.
Configure detected coding-agent hooks, then keep the daemon running.

apps.summary: Play touch-first Sudoku designed for an e-ink screen.
Play tic-tac-toe together on one Kobo.
Keep a simple to-do list that stays on your Kobo.
Play a deterministic touch-first backgammon board on one Kobo.
apps.page_description: Play a tactile 24-point backgammon board built for Kobo's paper-like display.

apps.summary: Browse a registered calibre-web OPDS library over HTTPS.
apps.page_description: Register an HTTPS calibre-web OPDS library and optionally attach a runtime-held Basic credential.

steps.text: Have an HTTPS calibre-web or calibre content-server OPDS endpoint ready.
For a private library, install its username and password as the named Basic credential used by the app.
If the server uses a private certificate authority, install that trust root separately.

apps.summary: Solve a compact touch-first crossword with clue navigation.
apps.page_description: Work through a compact crossword with cell-by-cell touch entry and clue navigation.

apps.summary: Trigger configured computer commands through a paired Sidekick daemon.
apps.page_description: A paired-computer command surface with large e-ink keys and confirmation for risky commands.

steps.text: Deck requires a compatible kobo-sidekickd build with the /deck routes and a deck.toml command map; those routes are not yet included in this repository.
Initialize the companion daemon to obtain its address, certificate, and pairing code.
Install the daemon certificate on the Kobo before pairing.

apps.summary: Track public AO3 works on an offline reader-first shelf.
apps.page_description: Enter an AO3 work URL or ID and keep its lookup entry on a reader-first shelf.

apps.summary: Log offline bird sightings and keep a local life list.
apps.page_description: A field-first eBird companion for cached species packs, fast offline sightings, life lists, and desktop CSV export.

apps.summary: Review a small offline queue of persistent flashcards.
apps.page_description: Review a small offline card queue with large reveal and answer controls made for an e-ink panel.

apps.summary: Display monochrome photos with awake or scheduled frame modes.
apps.page_description: Turn a Kobo into a low-power monochrome photo frame with awake and scheduled display modes.

apps.summary: Browse offline SRD references and manage tabletop combat.
apps.page_description: Offline SRD reference and table tools for spell lookups, monster stat blocks, dice, initiative, and party HP.

apps.summary: Track daily and weekday habits with local streaks.
apps.page_description: An offline-first habit tracker that puts today's commitments and streaks on a calm paper display.

steps.text: Standalone mode needs no account. Habitica mode requires an API credential installed under the exact name habitica.
Install the Habitica API token from a computer before enabling account mode.

apps.summary: Control saved Home Assistant tiles from a low-power panel.
apps.page_description: A low-power Home Assistant control panel with persisted tiles and compact template polling.

steps.text: Expose Home Assistant through HTTPS, using Nabu Casa or a reverse proxy with a trusted certificate.
Create a Home Assistant long-lived access token and install it under the exact name homeassistant.
For a private certificate authority, install its root on the Kobo.

apps.summary: Solve one deterministic offline five-letter puzzle each day.
apps.page_description: A deterministic offline five-letter daily puzzle whose shared answer comes from the date, not a server.

apps.summary: Browse cached Mealie recipes in a counter-friendly cooking view.
apps.page_description: A Mealie companion that keeps tonight's recipe legible, awake, and usable offline at the counter.

steps.text: Make the Mealie API available to the Kobo at https://mealie.local.
Create a long-lived Mealie API token and install it under the exact name mealie.

apps.summary: Download offline chess puzzles and check slow correspondence games.
apps.page_description: Offline tactics sessions and slow correspondence chess for an e-ink board.

steps.text: Anonymous puzzle use needs no account. Account play requires a Lichess personal access token.
Install the token under the exact name lichess.

apps.summary: Play four deterministic touch-first pencil-puzzle modes.
apps.page_description: Four touch-first pencil-puzzle modes with deterministic daily starting state and paper-like mark cycles.

apps.summary: Read converted scores with setlists and half-page turns.
apps.page_description: A Kobo score reader with stable stand mode, setlists, and two-stage half-page turns.

apps.summary: Count rows and browse synced Ravelry project patterns.
apps.page_description: A knuckle-sized row counter and offline pattern companion for Ravelry projects.

steps.text: Ravelry library sync requires an approved Ravelry API account and HTTP Basic credential.
Install the credential under the exact name ravelry.

apps.summary: Solve a bundled touch-first picture grid offline.
apps.page_description: Solve a touch-first picture grid by cycling each square through fill, X, and blank.

apps.summary: Read sideloaded CBZ comics or connect to a Komga library.
apps.page_description: Read your CBZ comics locally, with a self-hosted-library path for Komga.

steps.text: Local CBZ reading needs no service. Komga mode requires an HTTPS Komga OPDS endpoint.
For a private Komga library, install its HTTP Basic credential under the exact name komga.

apps.summary: Pair with a computer to mirror a terminal session on e-ink.
apps.page_description: Pair a Kobo with a computer to read a terminal session on an e-ink display.

steps.text: Paperterm's kobo stream TLS companion is not yet included in this repository; the current build provides the pairing and terminal-mirror interface only.

apps.summary: Play touch-first Reversi together on one Kobo.
apps.page_description: A pass-and-play board-game shelf, beginning with touch-first Reversi.

apps.summary: Play an original offline parser-based interactive story.
apps.page_description: A touch-first offline interactive-fiction MVP that sets an original story as a readable Kobo page.

apps.summary: Read and reply to completed letters from a Hermes gateway.
apps.page_description: A slow correspondence channel for a self-hosted Hermes gateway: read completed letters offline and send deliberate replies.

steps.text: Deploy a compatible Hermes gateway behind HTTPS and note its public URL.
Install the gateway bearer token under the exact name hermes-post.

apps.summary: Play offline solo or pass-around trivia rounds.
apps.page_description: Offline trivia rounds for one reader or a table passing one Kobo between players.

apps.summary: Sync a Wallabag queue for offline reading and archive actions.
apps.page_description: Offline Wallabag reading queue with daemon-held credentials and queued archive actions.

steps.text: Have an HTTPS Wallabag instance and a bearer credential accepted by its API.
Install that credential under the exact name wallabag.

apps.summary: Read batched Miniflux entries offline and queue read state.
apps.page_description: A Miniflux-backed e-ink reader that batches unread entries and retains offline state.

steps.text: Have an HTTPS Miniflux instance, either self-hosted or hosted, and create an API token.
Install the token under the exact name miniflux; the runtime sends it as X-Auth-Token.

apps.summary: Configure battery-conscious sync folders and schedules.
apps.page_description: Settings surface for duty-cycled Syncthing folders and battery-conscious scheduling.

steps.text: The current Store build is a settings preview; syncing requires a future Cobalt platform update that supplies and supervises the ARMv7 Syncthing binary.

apps.summary: Browse a pushed Markdown vault by note, tag, link, and backlink.
apps.page_description: A read-only offline note library for browsing Markdown, tags, links, backlinks, and search.

apps.summary: Read a deterministic public-domain poem each day.
apps.page_description: A deterministic daily public-domain poem with provenance-aware browsing and persisted favorites.

apps.summary: Browse Zotero collections, read metadata and indexed paper text, and keep papers available offline.

steps.text: Create a dedicated Zotero API key with read-only access to your personal library.
Copy the numeric user ID shown on the Zotero API key settings page. Zotero Reader asks for it on first launch.
Install the API key on your Kobo under the exact secret name zotero.
Launch Zotero Reader, enter the numeric user ID, and select a collection.
Direct mode reads indexed text. Structured PDF layout, tables, figures, formulas, and OCR require the optional self-hosted conversion service.
